metadata.name: liquid-staking-kelp-style-depeg-2026
metadata.description: Kelp-style / rsETH-style single-program depeg + withdrawal-run pressure replay against the liquid-staking-fork bundle. Scheduled slash at tick 3 drops the exchange rate; redemption demand at tick 4 exceeds reserve buffer and lands four accounts on the withdrawal queue; tick 5 partial claim settles only the reserve-covered position. Honest boundary: single-program pressure replay, not a cross-protocol contagion claim, not a real Kelp / rsETH codebase fork.
